mechanism: Polyethylene glycol (PEG) is an osmotic laxative that may reduce raloxifene absorption by increasing gastrointestinal transit time and altering the intestinal environment where raloxifene undergoes enterohepatic recirculation.
action: Separate administration by at least 2 hours; administer raloxifene first, then PEG-based laxatives to minimize interference with raloxifene absorption and efficacy.
